items.title: Bernstein backs these 2 metals and mining stocks amid market volatility
items.summary: Investing.com -- Bernstein has identified its top picks in the metals and mining sector following a significant market sell-off last week that hit commodity prices and equities hard. Freeport was among the worst 10 performing stocks in the S&P 500, alongside AI-focused names such as NVDA, as copper and gold prices fell significantly.
